title: Arogya Shield Plus — Product Overview
content: Arogya Shield Plus is a comprehensive family health insurance plan offered by ShieldCare Insurance Ltd. It provides cashless hospitalization, pre- and post-hospitalization coverage, day-care procedures, and annual health check-ups. Available for individuals and families (floater basis) with sum insured options of ₹3 Lakh, ₹5 Lakh, ₹10 Lakh, ₹15 Lakh, and ₹25 Lakh. The plan is renewable for life with no exit age after initial enrollment. It covers allopathic, AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy), and modern day-care treatments.

title: Plan Tiers — Silver, Gold, Platinum
content: Arogya Shield Plus offers three plan tiers: Silver (sum insured ₹3L–₹5L), Gold (sum insured ₹10L–₹15L), and Platinum (sum insured ₹25L). Silver covers basic hospitalization and 30-day care procedures. Gold adds maternity benefits (after 2-year waiting period), international emergency cover up to ₹5L, and mental health treatments. Platinum includes all Gold benefits plus annual preventive health check-up, personal accident cover (2x sum insured), and worldwide coverage up to ₹25L. All tiers include a No-Claim Bonus of 10% per claim-free year, up to 100% of base sum insured.

title: Eligibility — Age and Entry Requirements
content: Arogya Shield Plus is open to Indian residents between 18 and 65 years of age at the time of first enrollment. Children can be covered from 91 days to 25 years under the family floater plan. Senior citizens aged 60–65 may enroll subject to a pre-policy medical examination; a loading of 20% applies on premium for ages 60–65. The plan does not accept new enrollments above age 65, but existing members may renew for life. NRIs with valid Indian address proof and a valid Indian bank account are eligible.

title: Eligibility — Residency and Documentation
content: Applicants must be Indian residents or NRIs with a valid Indian address. Required documents for enrollment: (1) Government-issued photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, or Voter ID), (2) Address proof (Aadhaar, utility bill not older than 3 months, or bank statement), (3) Age proof (birth certificate, Aadhaar, or passport), (4) Recent passport-size photograph. For senior citizens (60+): a pre-policy medical examination report from an approved diagnostic center must be submitted within 30 days of application. For family floater: marriage certificate and birth certificates of dependents.

title: Premium Rates — Age Band Pricing
content: Indicative annual premiums for an individual policy (sum insured ₹10 Lakh, Gold plan): Age 18–35: ₹7,500/year; Age 36–45: ₹11,200/year; Age 46–55: ₹16,800/year; Age 56–65: ₹24,500/year (includes 20% senior loading for 60+). Family floater premium (2 adults + 2 children, sum insured ₹10L, Gold): approximately ₹19,000/year. Premiums are GST-exclusive; 18% GST is added. Premiums may vary based on add-ons, city of residence (Tier 1 cities carry a 5% surcharge), and pre-existing condition history. Exact premium is determined at underwriting.

title: Premium Payment Options
content: Premiums can be paid annually, semi-annually, or quarterly. Monthly payment is not available. A 2% discount is offered on annual payment. Accepted modes: net banking, UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), credit/debit card, NEFT/RTGS, and cheque drawn in favor of ShieldCare Insurance Ltd. Automatic renewal via standing instruction (SI) or NACH mandate is available. A grace period of 30 days is allowed after the due date for renewal payment; coverage lapses if payment is not received within the grace period.

title: Waiting Periods — Initial and Specific
content: Arogya Shield Plus has the following waiting periods: (1) Initial waiting period: 30 days from policy inception for all illnesses (except accidents). (2) Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period: 36 months of continuous coverage (reduced to 24 months for Gold and Platinum tiers). (3) Specific disease waiting period: 24 months for cataract, hernia, joint replacement, and sinusitis. (4) Maternity waiting period (Gold/Platinum only): 24 months from policy inception. (5) Critical illness waiting period (Platinum add-on): 90 days. Waiting periods are not applicable for treatment arising from accidents on or after policy inception date.

title: What is Covered — In-Patient Hospitalization
content: Arogya Shield Plus covers in-patient hospitalization expenses for minimum 24 hours of hospitalization: room rent (single standard AC room for Gold/Platinum; shared room for Silver), ICU charges, surgeon and anesthetist fees, nursing expenses, diagnostic tests, medicines, implants, and medical devices used during treatment. Road ambulance charges up to ₹3,000 per hospitalization are covered. Air ambulance charges are covered up to ₹2.5 Lakh per year under Gold and Platinum plans only.

title: What is Covered — Pre and Post Hospitalization
content: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered for 60 days before admission. Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for 90 days after discharge (180 days for Platinum). Covered pre/post expenses include: doctor consultation fees, diagnostic tests (blood tests, X-ray, MRI, CT scan), prescribed medicines, and physiotherapy. These must be related to the same illness or injury that caused the hospitalization.

title: What is Covered — Day-Care Procedures
content: Arogya Shield Plus covers over 550 day-care procedures that require less than 24 hours of hospitalization due to modern medical advances. Key examples: cataract surgery, chemotherapy, dialysis, lithotripsy, tonsillectomy, adenoidectomy, D&C (dilation and curettage), laparoscopic surgeries, and radiotherapy. Day-care procedures are covered across all plan tiers (Silver, Gold, Platinum). No sub-limit applies for day-care procedures.

title: What is Covered — AYUSH and Mental Health
content: Arogya Shield Plus covers AYUSH treatments (Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) for in-patient hospitalization in NABH-accredited facilities up to ₹30,000 per year (Silver) or ₹50,000 per year (Gold/Platinum). Mental health treatments including psychiatric consultations, medications, and in-patient psychiatric care are covered under Gold and Platinum plans up to ₹50,000 per year. OPD psychiatric consultations are covered under Platinum only (up to ₹10,000 per year).

title: Exclusions — What is NOT Covered
content: Arogya Shield Plus does NOT cover: (1) Self-inflicted injuries, suicide attempts, or acts committed under influence of alcohol/drugs. (2) Cosmetic and aesthetic treatments (including plastic surgery unless due to accident). (3) Dental treatment and oral surgery unless requiring hospitalization due to accident. (4) Infertility, IVF, and assisted reproduction. (5) Experimental or investigational treatments. (6) Treatment outside India (except emergency care under Gold/Platinum). (7) War, terrorism, nuclear hazards. (8) Non-allopathic OPD treatments (except AYUSH in-patient as noted). (9) Hearing aids, spectacles, and contact lenses. (10) Health supplements and vitamins unless prescribed during hospitalization.

title: Cashless Claim Process
content: For cashless hospitalization at a network hospital: (1) Inform ShieldCare TPA (Third Party Administrator) at least 3 days before planned hospitalization, or within 24 hours of emergency admission. (2) Show your ShieldCare e-card and photo ID at the hospital insurance desk. (3) TPA verifies coverage and issues pre-authorization within 2 hours for emergencies (4 hours for planned). (4) Hospital directly settles approved bills with ShieldCare. (5) Any non-payable items (deductibles, consumables, co-pay amounts) must be paid by the patient at discharge. TPA helpline: 1800-XXX-XXXX (24x7 toll-free).

title: Reimbursement Claim Process
content: For reimbursement claims (treatment at non-network hospitals or if cashless was not availed): (1) Pay the full hospital bill yourself at discharge. (2) Collect all original bills, discharge summary, prescription slips, diagnostic reports, and pharmacy receipts. (3) Submit the claim form along with all documents to ShieldCare within 30 days of discharge. (4) ShieldCare/TPA will process the claim within 7 working days of receiving complete documents. (5) Approved amount will be transferred to your registered bank account. Documents can be submitted via the ShieldCare mobile app, courier, or in-person at any branch.

title: Network Hospitals
content: Arogya Shield Plus provides cashless treatment at over 8,500 network hospitals across India. Major metros (Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune, Ahmedabad) have over 300 network hospitals each. Tier 2 cities are also well covered. To find a network hospital, visit www.shieldcare.in/network-hospitals, use the ShieldCare mobile app, or call 1800-XXX-XXXX. Non-network hospitals: reimbursement claims are accepted. Emergency treatment at any hospital in India is covered regardless of network status.

title: No-Claim Bonus and Restoration Benefit
content: No-Claim Bonus (NCB): For every claim-free policy year, the sum insured increases by 10% (base amount), up to a maximum of 100% bonus. NCB accumulates even if you switch plans within Arogya Shield Plus. If a claim is made, NCB is reduced by 20% of the accumulated bonus. Restoration Benefit: Under Gold and Platinum plans, once the sum insured is exhausted in a policy year due to a claim, it is automatically restored to 100% at no additional premium. The restored amount can be used for a different illness in the same policy year (not for the same illness/injury).

title: Policy Renewal and Portability
content: Arogya Shield Plus is a lifetime renewable policy with no exit age restriction post-enrollment. Renewal must be done before the policy expiry date or within the 30-day grace period. Portability: If you wish to switch to Arogya Shield Plus from another insurer, credit for the waiting period served under the previous policy is given (subject to IRDAI portability guidelines). Portability requests must be submitted at least 45 days before the existing policy's renewal date. Premium at renewal is based on the attained age and prevailing rate card at the time of renewal.

title: Tax Benefits Under Section 80D
content: Premiums paid for Arogya Shield Plus qualify for tax deduction under Section 80D of the Income Tax Act, 1961. Deduction limits: Up to ₹25,000 per year for individuals below 60 years (self, spouse, dependent children). Additional ₹25,000 for parents below 60 years. If either you or your parents are senior citizens (60+), the limit increases to ₹50,000 for that category. Maximum combined deduction: ₹1 Lakh per year. Premiums paid in cash are not eligible for Section 80D deduction; must be via non-cash modes. Preventive health check-up costs (up to ₹5,000) are included within the overall 80D limit.

title: Free Look Period and Cancellation
content: Arogya Shield Plus offers a 15-day free look period from the date of receipt of the policy document. During this period, you may review the policy terms and cancel if not satisfied. Upon cancellation within the free look period, the premium is refunded after deducting: (a) proportionate premium for days of coverage, (b) medical examination costs (if any), and (c) stamp duty charges. After the free look period, mid-term cancellation is not permitted (health insurance policies cannot be cancelled mid-term by the insured except for specific reasons; the company may cancel with 30 days' notice for misrepresentation or fraud).

title: Add-On Riders Available
content: Arogya Shield Plus offers the following optional add-on riders: (1) Critical Illness Rider: Lump-sum payout of ₹5L or ₹10L on diagnosis of 34 listed critical illnesses (cancer, heart attack, stroke, kidney failure, etc.), with 90-day waiting period. (2) OPD Cover Rider: Covers out-patient consultations, diagnostics, and pharmacy bills up to ₹15,000/year. (3) Maternity and Newborn Rider (Silver plan only): Adds maternity coverage for Silver plan with 24-month waiting period. (4) Hospital Cash Rider: Daily cash benefit of ₹500–₹2,000 per day for each hospitalization day. (5) Personal Accident Rider: Covers accidental death and permanent disability.

title: FAQ — Pre-existing Conditions
content: Q: I have diabetes and hypertension. Can I still get covered? A: Yes, Arogya Shield Plus does not reject applications solely based on pre-existing conditions like diabetes or hypertension. However, these conditions are subject to the pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period: 36 months for Silver plan, or 24 months for Gold/Platinum plans. This means claims related to diabetes or hypertension (and their direct complications) will not be covered during the waiting period. After the waiting period, full coverage applies for these conditions. Disclosure of pre-existing conditions is mandatory; non-disclosure may lead to claim rejection.

title: FAQ — Coverage for Pregnancy and Maternity
content: Q: Does the plan cover pregnancy and delivery? A: Maternity coverage is available under Gold and Platinum plans after a 24-month waiting period. Covered expenses include: normal delivery (up to ₹30,000), C-section delivery (up to ₹50,000), pre-natal consultations (4 visits), and newborn coverage from birth (as part of family floater). Newborn vaccinations up to ₹5,000 are also covered. Maternity is NOT covered under the Silver plan unless the Maternity and Newborn Rider is added. Complications of pregnancy (e.g., ectopic pregnancy, miscarriage requiring hospitalization) are covered without the maternity waiting period.

title: FAQ — Cashless at Any Hospital
content: Q: Can I avail cashless treatment at any hospital? A: Cashless treatment is available ONLY at ShieldCare network hospitals (8,500+ hospitals across India). If you are admitted to a non-network hospital, you will need to pay the bills yourself and then file for reimbursement. In case of a life-threatening emergency, cashless can be availed at any hospital in India; please call TPA immediately. Always verify network status before planned hospitalization via the app or helpline. The list is updated quarterly; it is advisable to check current network status before admission.

title: FAQ — Co-payment and Deductibles
content: Q: Is there any co-payment required? A: Co-payment applies in the following cases: (1) For insured members aged 60 and above: a 20% co-payment applies on each claim for Silver plan. Gold and Platinum plans have no co-payment for senior citizens. (2) Treatment in non-network hospitals: a 10% co-payment applies on reimbursement claims. (3) No co-payment applies for members below 60 at network hospitals. Deductible: An optional voluntary deductible of ₹5,000 or ₹10,000 can be chosen at enrollment, in exchange for a 5% or 10% premium discount respectively.

title: Objection Handling — Premium Too Expensive
content: Response to 'the premium is too expensive': Arogya Shield Plus is competitively priced considering the comprehensive coverage it provides. Consider these value points: (1) One hospitalization can cost ₹2–₹5 Lakh in a private hospital; the annual premium is a fraction of that. (2) Section 80D tax deduction saves ₹4,500–₹15,600 per year (depending on tax bracket). (3) The No-Claim Bonus increases your coverage by 10% every claim-free year at no extra cost. (4) Silver plan starts at just ₹625/month for a 30-year-old. (5) Family floater covers the entire family at 30-40% lower cost than individual policies for each member. (6) If cost is a concern, we can explore the Silver plan or add a voluntary deductible for a premium reduction.

title: Objection Handling — Already Have Employer Insurance
content: Response to 'I already have health insurance from my employer': Employer-provided group health insurance is valuable but has significant limitations: (1) Coverage typically lapses when you leave the job or retire — leaving you uninsured exactly when you may need it most (older age). (2) Sum insured under group policies is often limited (₹2–₹5L), insufficient for serious illnesses. (3) No No-Claim Bonus or personal restoration benefit. (4) Family members (parents) may not be covered. (5) Arogya Shield Plus serves as a personal backup or top-up, ensuring continuous coverage irrespective of employment status. Many customers maintain both. (6) Waiting periods start now — the earlier you enroll, the sooner pre-existing conditions will be covered.

title: Objection Handling — I Am Healthy and Do Not Need Insurance
content: Response to 'I am healthy, I don't need insurance': Health insurance is most valuable when purchased while healthy, because: (1) Premiums are lowest when you are young and healthy — the same coverage costs 2-3x more in your 50s. (2) Waiting periods for pre-existing conditions begin from enrollment — a condition diagnosed after purchase will be covered from day 1 (after the initial 30-day period). (3) Accidents can happen to anyone at any age and are covered from day 1. (4) Medical inflation in India is running at 15% per year; a ₹10L medical bill today may be ₹20L in five years. (5) Enrollment now ensures you are not rejected or loaded for a condition that develops later.

title: Objection Handling — Claim Settlement Concerns
content: Response to 'I've heard insurance companies reject claims': ShieldCare has a claim settlement ratio of 97.3% (as per IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25), one of the highest in the industry. Key protections for policyholders: (1) Pre-authorization for cashless ensures you know upfront what is covered. (2) All rejections must be given in writing with specific reasons cited from the policy document. (3) You can escalate to ShieldCare Grievance Redressal, and beyond that to IRDAI Bima Bharosa Portal or Insurance Ombudsman. (4) Full disclosure of pre-existing conditions at enrollment eliminates the most common ground for rejection. We recommend always reading your policy document when you receive it.

title: Enrollment Process — How to Apply
content: Enrollment in Arogya Shield Plus can be done through: (1) Online: Visit www.shieldcare.in, choose your plan, fill in the proposal form, upload documents, and pay premium online. Policy is issued digitally within 24 hours. (2) Phone: Call 1800-XXX-XXXX; a representative will guide you through the process and send a proposal link. (3) Agent: An authorized ShieldCare agent can assist with form filling and document submission. (4) Branch: Walk into any ShieldCare branch with documents and complete the process in person. After submission, the underwriting decision is communicated within 3 working days. For applications requiring medical examination, the policy is issued post-exam results.

title: Grievance Redressal and Escalation
content: If you have a complaint about Arogya Shield Plus or a claim decision: (1) Contact ShieldCare Customer Care: 1800-XXX-XXXX or grievance@shieldcare.in. (2) If not resolved within 15 days, escalate to ShieldCare Grievance Redressal Officer. (3) If still unresolved within 30 days, you can approach the IRDAI Integrated Grievance Management System (IGMS) at www.igms.irda.gov.in. (4) Insurance Ombudsman: You can file a complaint with the Insurance Ombudsman in your region for disputes up to ₹30 Lakh. (5) Consumer Forum: Disputes may also be filed at the appropriate Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission. Your rights as a policyholder are protected by IRDAI regulations.

title: Qualification Gate — Age Check
content: Lead qualification rule — Age: An applicant is eligible if they are between 18 and 65 years of age at the time of application. Children from 91 days to 25 years may be enrolled as dependents under a family floater plan. Applicants below 18 or above 65 cannot be enrolled as primary members. Applicants aged 60–65 require a pre-policy medical examination. If the caller's age is outside 18–65, the agent should politely inform them that they are not eligible for primary enrollment and offer to take their details for a callback when eligibility is possible, or refer them to senior citizen-specific products.

title: Qualification Gate — Residency Check
content: Lead qualification rule — Residency: An applicant must be an Indian resident (resident in India for at least 182 days in a financial year) or an NRI with a valid Indian address proof and an Indian bank account. Non-Indian nationals (foreign nationals residing in India) are not eligible for Arogya Shield Plus. If the caller is not an Indian resident or NRI, the agent should politely inform them that the plan is only available to Indian residents/NRIs and escalate the call to a senior representative to explore alternatives.

title: Qualification Gate — Coverage Need Assessment
content: Lead qualification rule — Coverage needs: After confirming eligibility (age + residency), assess the caller's needs: (1) Individual or family coverage? (2) Sum insured requirement (based on city tier and family size): Tier 1 cities recommend minimum ₹10L; Tier 2 recommend minimum ₹5L. (3) Existing coverage? (employer/group or individual policy). (4) Any specific health concerns or pre-existing conditions to disclose? (5) Budget range for annual premium. Based on these inputs, recommend the appropriate plan tier (Silver/Gold/Platinum) and generate a preliminary quote range. Do not give a final binding quote; inform the caller that the exact premium is confirmed at underwriting.

title: Escalation Rules — When to Transfer to Human Agent
content: Transfer the call to a human agent in these situations: (1) Caller explicitly asks to speak with a human. (2) Caller is highly agitated or distressed (3 or more expressions of frustration). (3) Medical emergency — caller or family member needs immediate hospitalization guidance. (4) Complex claim dispute — caller is disputing a rejected claim. (5) Caller asks questions that are not answerable from the knowledge base after 2 retrieval attempts. (6) Out-of-scope products or services (e.g., life insurance, vehicle insurance, loan products). (7) Caller provides conflicting information that cannot be resolved automatically (e.g., different ages given). When transferring, always inform the caller and provide a case reference number.

title: Unsupported Question Fallback Policy
content: When a caller asks a question that cannot be answered from the available knowledge base: The agent must say 'I'm sorry, I don't have specific information on that in my current knowledge base. I can connect you with a specialist who can answer that question accurately.' Do NOT guess, estimate, or fabricate information. Topics that are commonly out of scope: specific hospital billing details, individual claim status, account-specific policy changes, legal or medical advice, competitor product comparisons with specific pricing, and regulatory changes not yet reflected in the knowledge base. Always offer to escalate or provide the ShieldCare helpline (1800-XXX-XXXX) for such queries.

title: International Coverage — Emergency and Planned
content: International coverage under Arogya Shield Plus: Gold plan: Emergency medical treatment abroad is covered up to ₹5 Lakh per year (accidental emergencies only). Planned treatment abroad is not covered under Gold. Platinum plan: Worldwide coverage up to ₹25 Lakh per year for both emergency and planned treatment (subject to pre-authorization for planned treatment). Silver plan: No international coverage. For all plans, evacuation costs are covered separately up to ₹2 Lakh under Gold and ₹5 Lakh under Platinum. Receipts and medical records in English (or certified translation) must be submitted for international reimbursement claims.

title: Wellness and Preventive Benefits
content: Arogya Shield Plus includes wellness benefits: (1) Annual health check-up: Covered under Gold (once per 2 years) and Platinum (once per year) at empaneled diagnostic centers. Includes blood profile, lipid panel, ECG, and chest X-ray. (2) Telemedicine consultations: 6 free teleconsultations per year for all plan tiers via the ShieldCare app. (3) Wellness rewards: Members who complete annual health check-ups and maintain fitness milestones (via ShieldCare app fitness tracker) earn wellness points redeemable against renewal premium (up to 5% of premium). (4) Vaccination coverage: Covered under Platinum plan for adults (flu, pneumonia, Hepatitis B) up to ₹3,000 per year.

title: Digital Tools — ShieldCare Mobile App
content: The ShieldCare mobile app (available on iOS and Android) provides: (1) Policy management: view policy details, download e-card, update contact information. (2) Claim submission: submit and track reimbursement claims with document upload. (3) Network hospital locator: find cashless hospitals by city, specialty, or proximity. (4) Pre-authorization requests: initiate and track cashless pre-authorization. (5) Teleconsultation: access 6 free teleconsultations per year. (6) Renewal: pay renewal premium via UPI, credit card, or net banking. (7) Wellness tracker: track fitness goals and earn wellness rewards. Download: search 'ShieldCare' on App Store or Google Play.

title: Sub-limits and Room Rent Capping
content: Room rent limits under Arogya Shield Plus: Silver plan: Shared/general ward room; no private room unless medically necessary. Gold plan: Single standard AC room; no suite or deluxe room. If a higher room category is chosen by the patient, all associated expenses (surgeon, anesthetist, procedure costs) are proportionately reduced to what they would have been in the entitled room category. Platinum plan: No room rent restriction (any room category covered). ICU room rent: No separate sub-limit for ICU under any plan; ICU charges are fully covered within the sum insured. Room rent capping does not apply to day-care procedures.

title: Summary — Plan Comparison Table
content: Arogya Shield Plus plan comparison: SILVER — Sum Insured ₹3L/₹5L, Room: Shared ward, Pre-existing wait: 36 months, Maternity: Not covered (rider available), Restoration: No, NCB: 10%/year up to 100%, International: No, Co-pay 60+: 20%. GOLD — Sum Insured ₹10L/₹15L, Room: Single AC, Pre-existing wait: 24 months, Maternity: Yes (24-month wait), Restoration: Yes (different illness), NCB: 10%/year up to 100%, International: Emergency up to ₹5L, Co-pay 60+: None. PLATINUM — Sum Insured ₹25L, Room: Any room, Pre-existing wait: 24 months, Maternity: Yes (24-month wait), Restoration: Yes (different illness), NCB: 10%/year up to 100%, International: Worldwide up to ₹25L, Co-pay 60+: None. All plans include: 8,500+ network hospitals, cashless treatment, day-care procedures (550+), AYUSH in-patient, 6 free teleconsultations.
